title: Soul Life
description: The Official Datapack for Soul Life!
body:
Inspired by Grian's Life Series; **Secret Life.**


# Soul life Twist
Everyone has **5 lives** (1,500 soul)
5=Dark green
4=Lime
3=Yellow
2=Orange
1=Red

Killing Rules
Darkgreens and limes CANNOT KILL

Yellows can kill dark greens
Oranges can kill limes and dark greens
Reds can kill everyone

## SOUL MECHANIC

Each life stage you have 10 Hearts of Soul 

- Each Heart = 30 Soul

When you take damage, you lose soul.

You can attack someone to take their soul you gain ~50% of what they loose

If you run out of Soul you are eliminated from the series.
